verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official hosted remote MCP server, AgentOS MCP at https://mcp.airwallex.com/mcp. It uses OAuth against the production account, has documented safety defaults (no money-out actions by default) and a Claude Code connection command. Airwallex also ships a Developer MCP for the sandbox and an unauthenticated Docs MCP, plus one-step plugins for Claude Code and Cursor. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate successfully through these MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Airwallex AgentOS MCP lets agents read and write production Airwallex resources from non-terminal environments
Authentication uses OAuth against your production Airwallex account.
Connectors — the Airwallex CLI and the Airwallex AgentOS MCP server... plus the Airwallex Developer MCP for documentation lookups and sandbox testing.
The Airwallex developer connectors connects AI coding agents — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools — to Airwallex documentation and the Airwallex sandbox.
